messages:
sasha: quick sync — onboarding v2.1 model. asking for quick checks before we flip serving. weights are at s3://rwd-models/v2.1/sha-9f3b1, tokenizer files at s3://rwd-models/v2.1/tokenizer/*
raj: confirming I can see the weights path. pulling now. any special config flags?
alina: note: tokenizer has an odd byte-offsets behavior for non-ascii punctuation — saw misaligned spans in local decode. test with our golden span prompts.
sasha: thanks @alina — added a small golden set to the repo: repo:git.redwood/inference/onboard/v2.1/gold_prompts.jsonl (contains structured-output and span-check items)
kevin: quick config lint run: `rwd-lint config.yaml` returns two warnings: `max_seq_length` mismatch (config=2048, model=4096) and `use_fast_tokenizer: false` recommended for speed. want me to patch and submit PR?
sasha: please patch the max_seq_length to 4096. leave use_fast_tokenizer false for now until we validate byte offsets. add a comment in PR about tokenization edgecases.
jordana: I'll run the smoke toolcall harness against the canary endpoint once PR merges. what are the tool schemas we should exercise?
sasha: exercise the retriever tool (schema: `{"type":"retriever","args":{"k":5}}`), the calculator, and file-reader. Also include an intentionally malformed tool call to ensure graceful failure.
ops-bot: deploy-check triggered for service:inference-canary by jordana — status: queued
raj: local quick results: weights load ok, kv-cache warmup successful for 512 steps, but tokenizer decode of "café—test" produced offsets [0,3,4] instead of expected [0,4,5]. capturing logs.
alina: can you paste the decode snippet?
raj: ```python
from rwd_tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_files('s3://rwd-models/v2.1/tokenizer')
ids = t.encode('café—test')
spans = t.char_spans(ids)
print(ids)
print(spans)
```
raj: printed ids and spans in gist: https://gist.github.com/raj/12ab34 — looks like emdash handling maps to multiple bytes.
kevin: that's consistent with the fast tokenizer differences. If we switch to `use_fast_tokenizer: true` offsets will match the tokenizers used in eval harness. But we risk subtle detokenization differences.
sasha: decision: keep slow tokenizer for serving for now, add normalization shim in pre-tokenize to replace emdash with ascii hyphen for golden set inputs only. also file an issue for long-term fix.
jordana: launching smoke tests now (will post run id).
ops-bot: deploy-check update: status: running on host gpu-canary-03
eval-bot: started regression run against goldset id `onboard-v2.1-2026-03-15-01` — tests: structured-output, span-checks, toolcall-fallbacks
jordana: smoke run id `smoke-179034-01` started. hitting retriever -> ok, calculator -> ok, malformed toolcall returns 400 with helpful error, good. streaming behavior for streaming route looks normal.
raj: noted a small memory bump when batching 8 concurrent requests. batch size 8 peak GPU mem ~13.4GB vs expected 12.6GB. might be due to kv-cache warmup retention policy.
\eke: (typo, ignore)
kevin: replied to PR with config patch and comment about tokenizer shim + ticket linking. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/pulls/472
sasha: awesome — once PR merges, jordana can promote canary to dedicated for further load testing. keep the golden set runs daily for 48 hours to watch for regressions. any other blockers?
alina: I'll add a short eval that fuzzes punctuation around non-ascii to the regression suite.
raj: I'll follow up on the kv-cache retention tuning and run a perf matrix.
jordana: will schedule the dedicated promotion for Friday 09:00 UTC if no regressions.
sasha: thanks all :thumbsup: — leaving this thread as the single source of truth for v2.1 readiness. please ping here with any failures and paste small logs.
